ideas.title: Following the Money in the Feeding Our Future Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail of the Feeding Our Future scheme, including how the alleged perpetrators laundered the money and what assets were seized by the government.
questions: How did the alleged perpetrators launder the money?
What assets were seized by the government?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money in the Feeding Our Future scheme could lead to a deeper understanding of the alleged perpetrators' motives and methods. By investigating the financial trail, we may be able to identify other potential cases of fraud and corruption.
